comment: Named tidal gates. Timing rules are expressed relative to HW at a reference port. Values are placeholder pilot-book approximations to be verified at M10 — flagged 'unverified' until then.

gates.name: Alderney Race (Raz Blanchard)
gates.note: SW-going stream begins ~HW St Helier −1h30. Spring rates can exceed 9 kt; wind-against-current raises dangerous seas.

gates.name: Cap de la Hague inshore passage
gates.note: Adjacent to the Alderney Race; strong west-going ebb.

gates.name: Raz de Sein
gates.note: Slack ≈ HW Brest −0h30; pass at slack in any wind against tide.
